steps_per_candidate: DISCOVER: Record source URL and actual requested work, not general articles or recommendations.
VALIDATE: Check source date, direct employer/payer, amount/rate if published, scope, deadline, Uganda eligibility, payment rails and hidden costs; write UNKNOWN instead of guessing.
PRIORITIZE: Prefer short no-fee work with high skill fit and credible direct payment; discard stale, spam, fake token offers and pay-to-claim bounties.
PREPARE: Draft a concise truthful proposal with service, delivery steps, fee and allowed route; mark it DRAFT, not SENT.
CONTACT: Only send through a genuinely authenticated, explicitly permitted channel; otherwise report blocked with next manual step.
EXECUTE: Count contracted work only upon actual payer acceptance and terms; count completed work only with proof of delivery.
INVOICE: Request payment only for legitimate agreed work; reconfirm exact network and payee route.

RECEIPT: Count earnings only if an independently verified incoming chain transaction to the approved owner address or confirmed exchange account credit establishes actual receipt. Shared exchange memo and asset/network must match where relevant.
prohibitions: No invented salaries, employer identities or payment receipts
Never infer custodial exchange credit from a public transfer
Do not count fiat payments, testnet rewards, promises, platform credits or unclaimed points as coins received
reporting_contract: Every role must output its unique identifier, exact one parent identifier, source URL, own evidence check, uncertainty, best realistic paid next action, and verified payment amount only if independently confirmed. Managers challenge 50 workers across rotated runs; assistants independently audit director conclusions; directors consolidate and assign follow-ups; D09 verifies legitimacy and D10 monitors results.
payment_reference: ONLY owner-approved correct-network cryptocurrency receiving addresses in the public branch brief or a separately configured private directory. Verify the actual address with owner before payer sends, chain, token issuer/contract and memo if required. A deposit to a shared Binance address does not prove user credit.

tool_improvement.mission: Actively research other websites, safe public APIs, open-weight model resources, real freelance/bounty platforms, and productivity utilities worldwide that improve the legitimate crypto-paying work pipeline. Try bounded public read-only discovery where workflow tools allow. Screen provider reputation, terms, fees, restrictions, APIs, data quality, security and actual use evidence.
steps: Find original official service or open-source repository
Evaluate value against real paid work and current research gaps
Check technical access, authentication, local eligibility and charges
Use only public permitted read-only endpoint or explicitly approved connected tool
Record actual call results, real limitations and safe proposed next step
Share best source-linked nonduplicate findings to assigned manager/director
Never install third-party packages from an untrusted search result or send private data to a new service
